monitor.en: Researchers monitored the wetland for three years to track its recovery.
monitor.zh: 研究人员对该湿地进行了三年监测，以追踪其恢复情况。

monitor.en: Regulators must monitor emissions from factories located near residential neighborhoods.
monitor.zh: 监管机构必须监测居民区附近工厂排放的废气。

monitor.en: We monitor patient symptoms daily and adjust the dosage accordingly.
monitor.zh: 我们每日监测患者症状，并据此调整剂量。

optimize.en: Engineers optimized the algorithm to reduce processing time significantly.
optimize.zh: 工程师对算法进行了优化，显著缩短了处理时间。

optimize.en: Firms optimize their supply chains to lower costs and shorten delivery times.
optimize.zh: 企业优化供应链以降低成本并缩短交付时间。

optimize.en: Careful planning can optimize both performance and energy consumption.
optimize.zh: 周密规划可以同时优化性能和能耗。

presume.en: We presume that the missing data reflect recording errors rather than reality.
presume.zh: 我们推测缺失的数据反映的是记录错误，而非实际情况。

presume.en: The author presumes the reader already understands basic statistical methods.
presume.zh: 这位作者假定读者已经理解基本的统计方法。

presume.en: It would be unwise to presume that one trial proves the general case.
presume.zh: 认为一次试验就能证明普遍规律是不明智的。

promote.en: The university launched a campaign to promote academic integrity among students.
promote.zh: 该校发起了一场旨在促进学生学术诚信的活动。

promote.en: Regular exercise promotes both physical health and mental well-being.
promote.zh: 规律运动能促进身体健康和心理健康。

promote.en: Several senators promoted legislation aimed at reducing ocean pollution.
promote.zh: 几位参议员推动旨在减少海洋污染的立法。

propose.en: The committee proposed new standards for reporting clinical trial data.
propose.zh: 该委员会提出了临床试验数据报告的新标准。

propose.en: Economists proposed raising interest rates to control runaway inflation.
propose.zh: 经济学家提议提高利率以控制失控的通货膨胀。

propose.en: Several researchers proposed a simpler method for measuring soil quality.
propose.zh: 几位研究者提出了一种更简单的土壤质量测量方法。

refute.en: The evidence refuted the hypothesis that the two variables were unrelated.
refute.zh: 这些证据驳斥了「两个变量互不相关」这一假设。

refute.en: She refuted the critic's claim with three published studies.
refute.zh: 她用三项已发表的研究反驳了评论者的论断。

refute.en: New observations refuted earlier conclusions about the region's climate history.
refute.zh: 新的观测结果推翻了关于该地区气候历史的早期结论。

substantiate.en: The researcher substantiated her argument with data from two decades.
substantiate.zh: 这位研究者用 20 年的数据为自己的论点提供了实证支持。

substantiate.en: Claims about health benefits must be substantiated by reliable clinical evidence.
substantiate.zh: 有关健康益处的说法必须有可靠的临床证据加以证实。

substantiate.en: A single photograph could not substantiate the journalist's serious allegations.
substantiate.zh: 一张照片无法证实记者那些严重的指控。

undermine.en: Rumors about the accounting scandal undermined investor confidence in the company.
undermine.zh: 关于财务丑闻的传言削弱了投资者对该公司的信心。

undermine.en: Missing citations undermine the credibility of any published argument.
undermine.zh: 引用缺失会削弱任何已发表论点的可信度。

undermine.en: The new evidence appears to undermine earlier conclusions about regional rainfall.
undermine.zh: 新证据似乎削弱了关于该地区降雨量的早期结论。

utilize.en: Farmers utilize satellite images to predict crop yields more accurately.
utilize.zh: 农民利用卫星图像更准确地预测作物产量。

utilize.en: The laboratory utilizes advanced microscopes for material analysis.
utilize.zh: 该实验室使用先进的显微镜进行材料分析。

utilize.en: Small businesses can utilize shared cloud services instead of buying software.
utilize.zh: 小企业可以采用共享的云服务，而不必购买软件。

gauge.en: Researchers gauge public opinion by conducting monthly surveys.
gauge.zh: 研究人员通过每月开展调查来评估公众意见。

gauge.en: It is difficult to gauge the true scale of the damage.
gauge.zh: 很难准确评估破坏的严重程度。

gauge.en: Investors gauge the market's mood by tracking trading volumes.
gauge.zh: 投资者通过观察成交量来判断市场情绪。

harness.en: The company harnesses solar energy to power its manufacturing plants.
harness.zh: 该公司利用太阳能为其制造工厂供电。

harness.en: Teachers can harness digital tools to encourage collaborative learning.
harness.zh: 教师可以调动数字工具来促进协作学习。

harness.en: He harnessed public support to fund the new research center.
harness.zh: 他利用公众支持为新的研究中心筹集资金。

deploy.en: Engineers deployed a sensor network across the forest to measure moisture.
deploy.zh: 工程师在森林中部署了传感器网络来测量湿度。

deploy.en: The agency deployed extra staff during the emergency response.
deploy.zh: 该机构在应急响应期间调配了额外人员。

deploy.en: The startup deployed its new algorithm to millions of users.
deploy.zh: 这家初创公司向数百万用户推出了其新算法。

eliminate.en: The redesign eliminated most of the errors in data entry.
eliminate.zh: 这次重新设计消除了大部分数据录入错误。

eliminate.en: We eliminated unnecessary steps from the approval process entirely.
eliminate.zh: 我们彻底去掉了审批流程中不必要的步骤。

eliminate.en: The new treatment eliminated the symptoms within two weeks.
eliminate.zh: 这种新疗法在两周内消除了症状。

embody.en: The constitution embodies the values of equality and justice.
embody.zh: 宪法体现了平等与正义的价值观。

embody.en: Her leadership style embodies the ideals of collaborative research.
embody.zh: 她的领导风格体现了合作研究的理想。

embody.en: This museum's design embodies the cultural heritage of the entire region.
embody.zh: 这座博物馆的设计体现了整个地区的文化遗产。

endorse.en: Several leading scientists endorsed the statement published in Nature.
endorse.zh: 几位顶尖科学家赞同了《自然》杂志上发表的这份声明。

endorse.en: The board endorsed the proposal to expand the scholarship program.
endorse.zh: 董事会支持了扩展奖学金计划的提案。

endorse.en: The union endorsed the new contract after a lengthy negotiation.
endorse.zh: 经过漫长的谈判，工会认可了这份新合同。

augment.en: The new funding will augment the laboratory's existing research capacity.
augment.zh: 新拨付的资金将增强该实验室现有的研究能力。

augment.en: Teachers augment classroom lessons with interactive videos and discussion.
augment.zh: 教师用互动视频和讨论来丰富课堂内容。

augment.en: Combined data from both trials augmented the evidence for the treatment.
augment.zh: 两项试验的数据合并后加强了支持该疗法的证据。

impede.en: Poor internet access impedes progress for students in rural areas.
impede.zh: 网络接入不畅阻碍了农村学生的学业进展。

impede.en: Heavy rain may impede the researchers' ability to collect samples.
impede.zh: 大雨可能妨碍研究者采集样本。

impede.en: Bureaucratic delays often impede the implementation of effective policies.
impede.zh: 官僚主义的拖延常常妨碍有效政策的实施。

juxtapose.en: The exhibition juxtaposes traditional craft techniques with modern industrial design.
juxtapose.zh: 展览将传统手工艺技法与现代工业设计并置对照。

juxtapose.en: The author juxtaposes two conflicting accounts to highlight the disagreement.
juxtapose.zh: 作者把两种相互矛盾的叙述并置，以突出其中的分歧。

juxtapose.en: The professor juxtaposed economic data with public opinion polls.
juxtapose.zh: 教授将经济数据与民意调查结果进行了对照。

rectify.en: The auditor rectified the accounting errors before the report was published.
rectify.zh: 审计员在报告发表前纠正了账目错误。

rectify.en: The company quickly rectified the safety defect that regulators had identified.
rectify.zh: 公司迅速整改了监管机构发现的安全缺陷。

rectify.en: To rectify the imbalance, the fund allocated more grants to rural schools.
rectify.zh: 为纠正这种不平衡，基金会向农村学校分配了更多拨款。

temper.en: The central bank raised rates to temper rising inflation.
temper.zh: 中央银行提高利率以抑制不断上升的通货膨胀。

temper.en: She tempered her criticism with praise for the team's effort.
temper.zh: 她以对该团队努力的赞扬来缓和自己的批评。

temper.en: Adding shade trees helps temper the afternoon heat in the courtyard.
temper.zh: 种植遮荫树木有助于缓和庭院里午后的高温。

transcend.en: The debate over borders transcends national boundaries and political affiliations.
transcend.zh: 关于边界的争论超越了国界和政治立场。

transcend.en: Her poetry transcends cultural barriers and speaks to a global audience.
transcend.zh: 她的诗歌超越文化障碍，面向全球听众发出声音。

transcend.en: Some of the most useful ideas in science transcend narrow disciplines.
transcend.zh: 科学中一些最有用的思想超越了狭窄的学科界限。

warrant.en: The evidence warrants a full investigation into the reported misconduct.
warrant.zh: 这些证据足以对所报告的不当行为进行全面调查。

warrant.en: Such sweeping claims warrant closer scrutiny before they appear in print.
warrant.zh: 如此笼统的论断在付印之前有必要接受更仔细的审查。

warrant.en: The damage to the collection warrants immediate restoration work.
warrant.zh: 藏品所受的损坏有必要立即进行修复。

probe.en: Investigators probed the financial records for signs of hidden transactions.
probe.zh: 调查人员审查了财务记录，寻找隐藏交易的迹象。

probe.en: The mission will probe the ice layers for ancient air samples.
probe.zh: 这次考察将钻探冰层以获取古代空气样本。

probe.en: Reporters probed the minister about the funding decision repeatedly.
probe.zh: 记者反复追问部长关于资金决定的问题。

offset.en: Higher sales in Asia offset the decline in European markets.
offset.zh: 亚洲销量的增长抵消了欧洲市场的下滑。

offset.en: Energy efficiency can offset the rising cost of raw materials.
offset.zh: 能源效率的提高可以抵消原材料成本的上涨。

offset.en: A small grant helped offset the laboratory's mounting operating costs.
offset.zh: 一笔小额拨款帮助抵消了实验室不断上升的运营成本。

mean.en: The red warning light means the reactor has exceeded safe pressure levels.
mean.zh: 红色警示灯表示反应堆已超过安全压力水平。

mean.en: What do you mean by that vague phrase in the report?
mean.zh: 你所说的报告里那个含糊的措辞是什么意思？

mean.en: The survey results mean that most students prefer online coursework.
mean.zh: 调查结果表明，大多数学生更偏好线上课程。

generalize.en: It is risky to generalize from such a small sample size.
generalize.zh: 从如此小的样本量得出普遍结论是有风险的。

generalize.en: The theory generalizes well across cultures and historical periods.
generalize.zh: 该理论在不同文化和历史时期都有很好的适用性。

generalize.en: The team generalized the pilot results to the whole district.
generalize.zh: 团队将试点结果推广到了整个地区。

paraphrase.en: The journalist paraphrased the author's argument rather than quoting it directly.
paraphrase.zh: 这位记者转述了作者的观点，而非直接引用。

paraphrase.en: Could you paraphrase the main idea of the article in one sentence?
paraphrase.zh: 你能用一句话改述这篇文章的主要观点吗？

paraphrase.en: The lecture paraphrased several complex theories in accessible language.
paraphrase.zh: 这次讲座用通俗的语言转述了几个复杂的理论。

quote.en: The scholar quoted an ancient manuscript to support her interpretation.
quote.zh: 这位学者引用了一份古代手稿来支持她的解读。

quote.en: In his report, he quotes several witnesses describing the incident.
quote.zh: 在他的报告中，他引用了数位目击者对事件的描述。

quote.en: The article quotes a former official criticizing the policy.
quote.zh: 文章引用了一位前官员对该政策的批评。

caveat.en: The author added a caveat about the small sample size.
caveat.zh: 作者补充说明了一个关于样本量过小的限定条件。

caveat.en: One caveat: the data were collected before the policy took effect.
caveat.zh: 需要说明的是：数据是在该政策生效之前收集的。

caveat.en: We accept the estimate with the caveat that it lacks peer review.
caveat.zh: 我们接受这一估算，但要注意它尚未经过同行评审。

confound.en: Age may confound the relationship between diet and recovery.
confound.zh: 年龄可能混淆饮食与康复之间的关系。

confound.en: The researchers treated background noise as a confound in the experiment.
confound.zh: 研究者将背景噪声视为实验中的一个混杂因素。

confound.en: A major confound in the study was the absence of a control group.
confound.zh: 该研究的一个主要混杂因素是缺少对照组。

dataset.en: The team cleaned a dataset containing two million patient records.
dataset.zh: 团队清洗了一个包含 200 万份患者记录的数据集。

dataset.en: Access to a public dataset allows researchers to reproduce the results.
dataset.zh: 获取公开数据集使研究者能够复现实验结果。

dataset.en: Training models require larger datasets than most universities can gather.
dataset.zh: 训练模型所需的数据集比大多数大学能够收集的更大。

disparity.en: The report documents a widening disparity in access to health care.
disparity.zh: 该报告记录了医疗可及性上日益扩大的差距。

disparity.en: Income disparity between regions has grown significantly over the past decade.
disparity.zh: 过去 10 年里地区之间的收入差距显著扩大。

disparity.en: Scholars examined the disparity in exam scores across rural schools.
disparity.zh: 学者们考察了农村学校之间考试成绩的差异。

discourse.en: Academic discourse often rewards confident claims over careful evidence.
discourse.zh: 学术话语往往看重自信的论断而非细致的证据。

discourse.en: The conference addressed the discourse surrounding artificial intelligence in education.
discourse.zh: 会议讨论了围绕教育领域人工智能的话语。

discourse.en: Public discourse became polarized after the report was published.
discourse.zh: 报告发表后，公共话语变得两极分化。

distribution.en: The distribution of income in the country is highly unequal.
distribution.zh: 该国的收入分配极不平等。

distribution.en: Engineers changed the distribution of resources among the servers.
distribution.zh: 工程师改变了各服务器之间的资源分配。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across the region.
distribution.zh: 这张地图显示了降雨在该地区的分布情况。

diversity.en: The team values diversity in background, training, and research interests.
diversity.zh: 该团队重视背景、训练和研究兴趣上的多样性。

diversity.en: Urban forests contribute greatly to the diversity of local wildlife.
diversity.zh: 城市森林极大丰富了当地野生动物的多样性。

diversity.en: The course highlights the diversity of opinions within the field.
diversity.zh: 这门课程突显了该领域内观点的多样性。

endpoint.en: The sensor records the endpoint of each trip for billing purposes.
endpoint.zh: 该传感器为计费目的记录每段行程的终点。

endpoint.en: Researchers set a clear endpoint for the clinical trial.
endpoint.zh: 研究者为这项临床试验设定了明确的终点。

endpoint.en: The API defines the endpoint that clients call to fetch data.
endpoint.zh: 该接口定义了客户端获取数据时调用的端点。

error.en: The model introduced a small error when rounding the final value.
error.zh: 模型在最终数值取整时产生了一个小误差。

error.en: Human error accounted for most of the discrepancies in the report.
error.zh: 人为错误是报告中大部分差异的原因。

error.en: Standard error bars show the uncertainty around each estimate.
error.zh: 标准误差棒显示了每个估计值周围的不确定性。

evaluation.en: The evaluation revealed that the new curriculum improved retention.
evaluation.zh: 评估显示新课程提高了学生的留存率。

evaluation.en: Performance evaluation for managers occurs twice a year here.
evaluation.zh: 这里对管理者的绩效考核每年进行两次。

evaluation.en: Her evaluation of the theory was thorough and impartial.
evaluation.zh: 她对该理论的评价全面而公正。

fidelity.en: The model maintains high fidelity to the original manuscript.
fidelity.zh: 该模型对原始手稿保持了较高的保真度。

fidelity.en: Low audio fidelity made the recording difficult to understand.
fidelity.zh: 音频保真度低使这段录音难以听懂。

fidelity.en: The translator's fidelity to the author's tone was remarkable.
fidelity.zh: 这位译者对作者语调的忠实程度令人印象深刻。

finding.en: The main finding challenges earlier assumptions about regional development.
finding.zh: 这一主要发现挑战了关于区域发展的早期假设。

finding.en: Her laboratory reported a significant finding about the chemical compound.
finding.zh: 她的实验室报告了关于该化合物的一项重要发现。

finding.en: The research team's findings have been published in several journals.
finding.zh: 该研究团队的发现已在数家期刊上发表。
